text: This solution, DRRS Fiji: Disaster Risk Finance Specialist Engagement addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Fiji between Government of Fiji, Fiji's Ministry of Finance, Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO), Pacific Islands Forum Secretariat (PIFS), and The Global Shield against Climate Risks. The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
